description: Saves one file the signer uploaded (a photo ID, a W-9) to this machine. Get the file id from check_envelope, where each uploaded file is listed with its id (att_...). Signed PDFs, uploaded files and answers are deleted 30 days after the envelope closes, so the sender should keep their own copy.

file_id.description: The file id from check_envelope, e.g. att_0123456789abcdef.

save_path.description: Full path to write the file to, keeping its extension, e.g. C:\Users\me\Documents\id.jpg

name: download_attachment
title: Download a file the signer uploaded
